Name: Eliel the Mesobaite
Summary: Mighty man of David, named among the Mesobaites.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:47: Mighty man of David, named among the Mesobaites.
LifeLesson: The mention of Eliel in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
